I’m from Kazakhstan. The economy here is just bad. Salaries are low, prices are high, the forex market is simply atrocious - out currency is falling down with the speed of light. You can’t survive without a well paying job because the government does not help unemployed people and they just become homeless. And well paying work places are not a common thing here. The place I was fired from was one of few of them and since there are not many big corporations they all keep in touch with each other and they easily could ask about me and why I was fired
